**Opened PR #895 for #886 mrAutoMerge — 13 commits, fresh review REVISE fixed before push, two maintainer acts pending (live capture, brain:promote)**

**What**: PR #895 (Closes #886, Parent #864, type:feature) opened 2026-09-09 from feat/issue-886-featvcs-mrautomerge-merge-by-tier-on-the (worktree brain-issue-886), head e14560a8, 13 commits: 8 apply commits, 4 review-correction commits (d8eb3aa5 fail-open fix, 9956d9d6 never-throws + todo gate, bdf499c5 hygiene, 2c9ff789 tasks note), 1 record-first commit (rec-05767bed7024aee4). CI expected red on local-checks (drift guard :82) until the maintainer's promotion commit.

**Why**: D5 of the #886 ruling makes the PR two-author by design; the live capture of GitHub's 'auto-merge is not allowed' stderr (tasks 2.1) is done by the maintainer against this very PR (allow_auto_merge false re-checked before handover).

**Where**: PR #895; brain/scripts/vcs/**; openspec/changes/issue-886-mr-auto-merge/**.

**Learned**: the auto-mode classifier blocks an Agent launch whose prompt authorises `gh pr merge` and pushes; split the batch (agent commits locally, orchestrator pushes/opens the PR, maintainer runs the merge-arming capture). A fresh opus reviewer before push paid for itself: fail-open guard (`> 0` vs null/NaN), never-throws holes, and a todo test that would have passed with a placeholder fixture.

**Next**: (1) maintainer runs `gh pr merge 895 --auto --squash --repo csrinaldi/brain` and pastes stderr → fixture recorded:true, regex, un-todo, push; (2) maintainer runs brain:promote on the branch → drift guard green; (3) brain:review 895; (4) merge; (5) sdd-verify + archive.
